title: CPF Module Schema: Managed Redis module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-managedredis'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

access_keys_authentication_enabled.description: Whether access key authentication is enabled on the Azure Managed Redis default database.

access_policy_assignments.type: map(object({ name = string object_id = string access_policy_name = optional(string, "default") }))
access_policy_assignments.description: (Optional) Map of Entra ID access policy assignments for the Managed Redis database. This enables data plane access using Entra ID authentication. object({ name = "(Required) The name of the access policy assignment. Must be alphanumeric only (A-Z, a-z, 0-9), 1-60 characters. No hyphens or special characters allowed." object_id = "(Required) The principal ID (Object ID) of the user, service principal, or managed identity to be assigned the access policy." access_policy_name = "(Optional) The name of the access policy to assign. Defaults to 'default'. Currently only 'default' is supported by the API." })

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

client_protocol.description: Client protocol for Azure Managed Redis. Encrypted = TLS, Plaintext = non-TLS

cmk_key_name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_role_assignment.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the service identity to allow access to the key vault keys.

customer_managed_key.type: object({ key_vault_id = string expiration_date = string identity_id = string identity_principal_id = string })
customer_managed_key.description: (Required) An customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." identity_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key. To be used if `use_system_assigned_identity` is set to `false`" identity_principal_id = "(Required) The principal ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." })

default_database.type: object({ clustering_policy = optional(string, "OSSCluster") eviction_policy = optional(string, "VolatileLRU") geo_replication_group_name = optional(string, null) persistence_append_only_file_backup_frequency = optional(string) persistence_redis_database_backup_frequency = optional(string) module = optional(list(object({ name = string args = optional(string) }))) })
default_database.description: (Required) Default database configuration block for the Managed Redis instance. object({ clustering_policy = "(Optional) Clustering policy for the database. Defaults to 'OSSCluster'." eviction_policy = "(Optional) Eviction strategy when memory is full. Defaults to 'VolatileLRU'." geo_replication_group_name = "(Optional) Geo-replication group name shared across all participating regions." persistence_append_only_file_backup_frequency = "(Optional) AOF backup frequency." persistence_redis_database_backup_frequency = "(Optional) Full Redis database backup frequency." module = "(Optional) List of Redis Enterprise modules with fields 'name' and 'args'." }) The default database controls clustering, persistence, and geo-replication behavior and is required for Redis Enterprise.

enable_geo_replication.description: (Optional) Enable geo-replication for this Managed Redis instance.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

geo_replication_config.description: (Optional) Configuration for geo-replication. Required when enable_geo_replication is true. object({ linked_redis_cache_ids = "(Required) List of linked Managed Redis resource IDs (1-4 instances). The primary Redis ID is automatically included." }) Note: All linked Redis instances must: - Have the same geo_replication_group_name in their default_database configuration - Be in different Azure regions - Use the same SKU - Maximum of 5 total instances (primary + 4 replicas)

high_availability_enabled.description: (Optional) Determines whether high availability is enabled for the Managed Redis instance. When enabled, Azure Redis Enterprise provisions a 2-node replica set to ensure automatic failover. Changing this value forces a new Managed Redis instance to be created. Defaults to true.

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Managed Redis. Possible values are `SystemAssigned`, `UserAssigned`, `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned` (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this Managed Redis. This is required when `type` is set to `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned`." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on the Key Vault Key.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sku_name.description: (Required) Allowed SKU families: MemoryOptimized_*, ComputeOptimized_*, Balanced_*. FlashOptimized_* SKUs are out of scope as per Cyber Security controls.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

hostname.description: The hostname of the Azure Cache for Redis.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Azure Managed Redis.

name.description: The name of Azure Managed Redis.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Managedredis' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
